Derive a unit's reference panel and contamination screen from stored hits

Source: R/blast_genbank.R
derive_blast_products.Rd

Reads blast_hits rather than a hits file, so thresholds can change without re-running a remote search. Replaces the unit's rows in blast_ref_candidates and blast_screen and updates assemblies.blast_*.

Usage

derive_blast_products(
  con,
  id,
  path = 1L,
  scaffold = 1L,
  ts = as.integer(Sys.time()),
  review = FALSE
)

Arguments

con

Open project DB connection.

id

Sample ID.

path, scaffold

Assembly unit within the sample.

ts

Timestamp to stamp the written rows with.

review

TRUE derives the products of the contig's review copy: it reads review_blast_hits, replaces the row in review_blast_screen, and sets or clears the blast_* summary in review_units. The candidates only pick the top hit; blast_ref_candidates is never written, and the source label still comes from blast_searched.

Value

(invisibly) the ranked candidate data.frame.
